name: forensic-file-tracker
description: Cloudflare-only forensic copy file tracking: Logpush -> R2 -> Workers (+ D1)

LOGS_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket both Logpush jobs write into (`forensic/` = DLP forensic copies, `http/` = Gateway HTTP). Use the name of the bucket your Logpush jobs already target.

DB.description: D1 database for file-transfer records (email, device, time, host, application, filename). Created automatically on first deploy; the Worker creates its own tables.

LOOKUP_TOKEN.description: Bearer token for `/api/*` and `/forensic/*`, which return who-sent-what and real uploaded file contents. Generate a long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.

HTTP_LOG_PREFIX.description: R2 prefix of the Gateway HTTP Logpush job. Must match the job destination path.

FORENSIC_LOG_PREFIX.description: R2 prefix of the DLP forensic copies Logpush job. Must match the job destination path.

FILES_PREFIX.description: R2 prefix where extracted file bytes are stored. Must not overlap the two Logpush prefixes.

MAX_OBJECTS_PER_RUN.description: Max new Logpush objects ingested per prefix per cron run (every minute).

LOOKBACK_DAYS.description: How many UTC date folders (today and back) each run scans; also how far the first run backfills.

MAX_LOOKUP_OBJECTS.description: Max R2 objects scanned per prefix for one lookup request.
